name: SBFC Finance Ltd
title: SBFC Finance Ltd - 543959 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: SBFC guides flat 5-7% quarterly growth and 5bp credit cost range, with spreads held at 9% and opex down 20-25bp; no capacity-discipline signal, but branch expansion is paused in weaker pockets.

triggers.label: Branches 251, stabilise at 275
triggers.quote: We expect to stabilize at 275 branches during the year, allowing us to consolidate and evaluate the performance of these investments before scaling further.

triggers.label: Growth guided 5-7% quarterly
triggers.quote: Our overall guidance remains unchanged at 5% to 7% on a quarterly basis.

triggers.label: Spreads held at 9%
triggers.quote: We are expected to hold the spreads at the current level.

guidance.quote: Our overall guidance remains unchanged at 5% to 7% on a quarterly basis.
our opex is expected to decline by 20 to 25 basis points through the year.

guidance.value: range-bound, about 5 bps benefit here or there
guidance.quote: we are expected to remain range-bound all through the year with some marginal benefits of 5 basis points here or there.
We are expected to hold the spreads at the current level.
We expect to stabilize at 275 branches during the year

red_flags.label: Stage 2 rose from ~6% to 16%
red_flags.quote: our stage 2 moved up from almost 6% to 16%

red_flags.label: Gold growth mostly price-driven
red_flags.quote: most of the growth that's even come for us is largely on account of price

evasions.quote: we cannot comment on what is not in our hands
Unlikely, but let's probably clarify to you offline on this one.
